description: This file defines a notes service module that encapsulates CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations and real-time subscription capabilities for a 'notes' table in a database, using Supabase client. It includes functions for listing, fetching, creating, updating, deleting notes, and subscribing to real-time changes.

methods.name: handleResponse({ data, error })
methods.description: Utility function to handle responses from Supabase, logging errors with detailed info and throwing errors if any occur.

methods.name: listNotes()
methods.description: Fetches all notes ordered by the 'updated_at' timestamp descending. Returns an array of notes or an empty array on failure.

methods.name: getNote(id)
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its ID. Returns the note object or null if not found or on error.

methods.name: createNote({ title, content })
methods.description: Creates a new note with a title and optional content. Returns the created note or throws an error if creation fails.

methods.name: updateNote(id, data)
methods.description: Updates a note identified by ID with provided data. Returns the updated note or null on failure.

methods.name: deleteNote(id)
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID. Returns true if successful, false otherwise.

methods.name: subscribeToNotes(onChange)
methods.description: Subscribes to real-time changes on the 'notes' table if enabled, invoking a callback on data changes. Returns an unsubscribe function.

ctags.name: title
ctags.pattern: /^    const payload = { title, content: content ?? '', created_at: now, updated_at: now };$/

fields.name: const payload = { title, content: content ?? '', created_at: now, updated_at: now };
